purpose: Null control for the F2 frozen-state judge: the production selection (S0) against itself with one extra generator draw after the importance nodes (S0_reseeded), so that sieve and nodes are identical and only the local search's randomness differs, on the twelve development states. Its verdict rates are the floor against which the F2 treatment contrasts are read.
